adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `calendarReference` was changed from a single reference to an array via `filter(...)` (handling multiple `_calendar` refs). However, in the `if (newBookingId)` merge/delete block it still uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))` to pick only one old calendar reference to delete. With the new multi-destination/collective behavior (multiple calendar references), this will delete just the first matching reference and can leave other hosts’ old calendar events orphaned.
